en: This is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a scenic rural landscape with a small industrial area or mill, surrounded by dense forest, a winding river, and hills in the background. A railway with visible tracks runs through the lower part of the image. Some houses and industrial buildings are present, with a tall chimney at the center. There is a printed caption in Swedish at the bottom left that reads 'Motiv från Nedansjö'. On the back, there is pre-printed text from 'Axel Eliassons Konstförlag, Stockholm', and a hand-written Swedish note.
